title: Three Winters and One Short Pantry
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：food　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 food 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my grandmother ① cooked the food that no neighbour in the street would have tasted, and she said the cooking was the whole of the winter. The ② food, meaning the meal itself and not the recipe, ran three winters and stayed untasted in the book; food, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left untasted.

Every ③ kind of food in that kitchen had the same short pantry beside it, and the ④ food at the far shelf, meaning the part they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. Food, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to taste; my grandmother said the tasting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the food was the whole of the matter, meaning the thought and not the meal. The ⑥ food, meaning the thought and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody tastes; food, he said, is either something you cook or the only word that means both a meal and food for thought. He said the thought is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ food had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short pantry. The ⑧ food of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one street and three winters of tasting; food, she said, is either the part at the far shelf or the reason you learned to taste. She said the tasting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ food I remember is the part tasted in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the street. ⑩ Food, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being tasted; all food, she said, is food for thought that has agreed to look like a meal. She said the thought was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 食物（指厨房里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 食物（指那一餐本身，与食谱相对）
C. 固定搭配：cook the food 烹制食物
D. n. 食物（指留给孩子们的那一部分）
E. n. 食物（抽象总称，指一条街上的做饭之事）
F. n. 食物（指计划里写到、被尝过的那一部分）
G. n. 精神食粮；思考的材料（food for thought，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 精神食粮（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: cooked the food that no neighbour in the street would have tasted
The food, meaning the meal itself and not the recipe
Every kind of food in that kitchen
the food at the far shelf
the food was the whole of the matter
the food had become a line in a plan
The food of the whole thing

answers.why: cook the food 意为“烹制食物”，1964 年祖母烹制了街上没有一位邻居肯尝的食物。
food 意为“食物”，指那一餐本身而不是食谱，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被尝过。
food 意为“食物”，指厨房里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一间矮矮的储藏室。
food 意为“食物”，指留给孩子们的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
food 意为“精神食粮、思考的材料”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份思考的材料就是那件事的全部。
food 意为“精神食粮”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一餐饭，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
food 意为“食物”，指计划里写到、被尝过的那一部分，到 1971 年这一部分成了计划里的一行。
food 意为“食物”，祖母一月写道，整件事的做饭之事是一条街道和三个冬天的品尝。
food 意为“食物”，我记得的是计划里尝过的那一部分，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一部分。
food 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，食物是唯一会因为被好好品尝而变得更好的东西。
